entities.summary: Mario Jose Santiago Hernandez is a Puerto Rican baseball pitcher who is a free agent. He has previously played in the KBO League for the SK Wyverns and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Hanshin Tigers. He bats and throws right-handed.
